name: Segregation
overview: Scripture reveals that division and segregation among people undermine unity and stability, as Jesus taught that a kingdom or house divided cannot stand (Matthew 12:25). God created all nations from one blood and established their boundaries, emphasizing our shared origin and equal standing before Him (Acts 17:26; Romans 10:12). The New Testament urges believers to reject those who cause divisions contrary to sound doctrine and to pursue oneness in Christ, reflecting the unity between the Father and the Son (Romans 16:17; John 17:21). Even historical examples, such as the separation seen in Nehemiah's time, highlight the consequences of mixing that led to spiritual challenges (Nehemiah 13:23).
